body:
For this particular issue someone would need to create its own material just for the `EditorNode3DGizmoPlugin::ON_TOP` state of the gizmo which is currently not covered because there is no material for it in the server debug.

More Info:

That editor debug is not fully controlled by the gizmo, the material is the shared server material that has xray and color from the project settings. The runtime debug is coming from the actual node and uses the same material and settings.

To be clear, there are two separated debug renderers for obstacles.

The one in the editor that included editing handles and points is rendered by the actual gizmo obstacle plugin found in `modules\navigation_3d\editor\navigation_obstacle_3d_editor_plugin`. That one checks if the gizmo is selected and not in a HIDDEN state before drawing anything, else it clears. Aka only the selected node gizmo should still be visible when the overall gizmo state is HIDDEN else you would not see editing handles.

The one that renders at runtime with debug navigation hint is more permanent and rendered by the NavigationObstacle3D node directly and uses the NavigationServer3D debug materials and properties. it also uses the ProjectSetting debug material and settings but those are only loaded at the start, for later changes a script is needed that calls the server api. Any editor change, including gizmo toggles and "game mode" overlay, that happens while that runtime is going is irrelevant for this runtime debug because the editor does not forward those changes to the runtime instance.

In the end this is just the ancient old issue that the debug is not centralized and done by the server, see proposal https://github.com/godotengine/godot-proposals/issues/7208. Instead editor does its own thing and because editor does not exist in the runtime the runtime needs to also do its own thing. Since the editor does not forward many changes or has callbacks for them both the server and nodes are not aware what the editor is doing.
The main problem here is that the Editor has no reasonable way to forward the changed gizmo state else it could just edit the global obstacle debug material on the NavigationServer.
This issue is very annoying. I can't understand what I am looking at because it shown the obstacles through everything.
